arithmetic_method: Independent NumPy binary64 exact products, NumPy FP32 casts, and exact Fraction nearest-interval checks for every actual BF16 value and donor.
row_search_method: Every saved row starts eligible; independently generated output constraints eliminate rows; all surviving rows are then recomputed by direct products for every source.
limits: This numerical check does not identify the dynamic donor register, interrupted instruction, event time, or causal hardware mechanism.
Many saved rows are byte-identical. Matching row counts are eligible row indices, not independent distinct activation vectors.
Only the terminal failure record in each arm is decoded here; whole retained streams are rehashed and joined to the independent complete-stream audits.
Unstored odd-M accumulators and overwritten original source values remain unobserved.
Model names are labels from the pinned author reports; the checked donor bases are 0x0810 and 0x1010, each plus 0x200 times wave.
